text:
Evan: Vendor dropped the final pen-test intake PDF and they flagged 3 medium vulns + 1 high. Need to lock a retest window and hammer out RBAC/KMS evidence flow. Proposing retest window May 8-10 02:00-06:00 UTC. Any blockers?
Priya: KMS questions — will assessors need direct decrypt access or can we provide pre-signed artifacts? We want to avoid handing out long-lived keys.
Sam: Prefer presigned artifacts. For any live verification they can assume an ephemeral role with kms:Decrypt scoped to the evidence bucket only. Session TTL 1h.
Ava: Also need to confirm that key rotation won't invalidate snapshots used for proofs. If rotation lands between retest and evidence collection we lose chain. Can we freeze rotation for the window?
security-bot: New ticket created: VULN-2413 (privilege-escalation) assigned to @Evan. Evidence tag: pen-test-2026-05.
Evan: Yes — ops can hold rotation for 72h around the retest start. @Jordan can you confirm?
Jordan: Confirmed. We'll set a rotation hold via KMS flag and document in the change log. Impact: none on production for 72h. Will post the rollback plan.
Priya: Who will be the readroom liaison? We need one person for creds handoff and one for evidence manifest verification. Also require an audit log snapshot before handoff.
Sam: I can be liaison for evidence manifest. Steps I'd like in runbook: 1) snapshot CloudTrail logs for last 7 days, 2) export relevant app logs to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/{run-id}/, 3) generate manifest.json with SHA256 checksums.
Evan: Good. Command to bundle logs (run on ops bastion):
```bash
run-id=pt-4805
mkdir -p /tmp/$run-id && aws s3 sync s3://app-logs/prod/ /tmp/$run-id/ --exclude '*' --include "*2026-05-0[1-9]*"
sha256sum /tmp/$run-id/* > /tmp/$run-id/manifest.sha256
aws s3 cp /tmp/$run-id/ s3://redwood-pt-evidence/$run-id/ --recursive --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
Priya: Perfect. For the ephemeral role, here's the minimal IAM we should use (policy snippet):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/pt-evidence-key"]}
  ]
}
```
Sam: Couple notes: 1) Add kms:GenerateDataKey if vendors need to run encryption tests. 2) Make sure `Condition` ties to the session tag `aws:PrincipalTag/assessor=true` so we can audit who used the role.
Ava: Audit logging checklist: - Snapshot CloudTrail (management events) - Snapshot VPC flow logs for the window - Export user activity from our access proxy (oidc logs) - Preserve agent logs from staging infra
Evan: We'll attach a short presigned URL approach for quick artifact download. Presigned link TTL 6h. After upload, Sam generate manifest and post S3 path to this thread.
Priya: Also add an evidence retention note: keep artifacts for 90 days in a locked bucket with object-lock governance. We'll need this for compliance review.
Jordan: Planning note: Dedicated capacity might see a few extra inference spikes if vendor runs load-based tests. Ops will earmark 2 spare GPU nodes to route away from production during the test hours.
Evan: Action items: @Jordan hold KMS rotation + reserve capacity, @Sam evidence manifest + liaison, @Priya coordinate vendor creds + compliance retention, @Ava audit snapshots. Can everyone ack and I'll lock schedule?
Sam: Ack.
Priya: Ack.
Jordan: Ack. Will post the rotation freeze ticket ID when created.
Ava: Ack. I'll kick off the log export job 24h before window. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Reminder: runbook template updated at https://confluence.redwood.ai/pt-runbooks/retcon-template (auto-post)
Evan: Thanks all — locking retest window now and will upload the intake summary + next steps.
